I appreciate the initial notes in the status page. The Friday window hit our peak checkout traffic and we saw a 5x latency spike plus a 12% error rate on the embedding service — this directly impacted conversions. Our CFO is asking for a formal RCA and a remediation plan with dates; they want executive sign-off before we relax our monitoring thresholds. Can Redwood commit to: (1) a written RCA by EOD Monday, (2) a patch timeline for the hotfix, and (3) a follow-up governance review once mitigations are in place?

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Product, HyperMart

PS — please include the SLO delta and any fallback routing changes in the plan.

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@hypermart.com>
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service instability Friday night / request for formal RCA and commitment

Alex — thanks for the note and the ask. We own this with you. Attaching the formal RCA PDF and our proposed remediation roadmap for executive review (attachment: 2026-04-19_HyperMart_RCA.pdf). High level summary up front:

- Root cause: a KV-cache invalidation loop compounded by a recent kernel selector change on the 1.1.3 model variant, which increased per-token CPU and caused backpressure across inference workers.
- Impact: episode lasted 37 minutes during your 20:43–21:20 PDT peak window. Estimated 12% request error rate for generation endpoints and 4.8s median tail latency increase.
- Immediate mitigations performed Friday: rolled routing to 1.0.9 fallback, increased autoscale headroom + prefix caching enabled for hot customer keys.

Deliverables we are committing to:
1) Formal RCA (attached) — delivered now.
2) Hotfix (kernel patch + config lock) — staging test by Wed 22 Apr, production rollout Thu 23 Apr (low-risk canary then wider).
3) Post-rollout governance review with HyperMart execs and Redwood SRE on Fri 24 Apr 14:00 PDT.
4) A 90-day follow-through plan with automated regressions tests and monthly SLO reports.

I have flagged this with Jonas and Marcus for SRE verification and with Kimberly/David for account coordination.

- Irene
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
Attachment: 2026-04-19_HyperMart_RCA.pdf

Acknowledged. Quick technical addendum for the record: we reproduced the KV invalidation loop locally when the sequence length distribution hit a pathological tail and the kernel selector applied a higher-memory execution path which evicted shared caches faster than expected. The hotfix is two-fold: (A) enforce explicit cache TTLs per-tenant and (B) adjust kernel selection heuristics for short-sequence bursts. We'll attach the patch diff (hotfix_patchnotes.diff) to the staging PR. Est. risk: low; rollback window available.

Action items for SRE:
- Marcus to open INF-4321 and link the test run artifacts (in progress).
- Schedule canary on a single region at 02:00 UTC Thu 23 Apr.

Marcus Lin
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
